ayahs.en: By the sky containing great stars
ayahs.e2: By the sky full of constellations

ayahs.en: And [by] the promised Day
ayahs.e2: and the promised Day ˹of Judgment˺

ayahs.en: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed
ayahs.e2: and the witness and what is witnessed

ayahs.en: Cursed were the companions of the trench
ayahs.e2: Condemned are the makers of the ditch—

ayahs.en: [Containing] the fire full of fuel
ayahs.e2: the fire ˹pit˺, filled with fuel—

ayahs.en: When they were sitting near it
ayahs.e2: when they sat around it

ayahs.ar: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودࣱ‏
ayahs.en: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses
ayahs.e2: watching what they had ˹ordered to be˺ done to the believers
ayahs.tr: Wa hum 'alaa maa yaf'aloona bilmu 'mineena shuhood

ayahs.ar: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
ayahs.en: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy
ayahs.e2: who they resented for no reason other than belief in Allah—the Almighty, the Praiseworthy—
ayahs.tr: Wa maa naqamoo minhum illaaa aiyu'minoo billaahil 'azeezil Hameed

ayahs.ar: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءࣲ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.en: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness
ayahs.e2: ˹the One˺ to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is a Witness over all things
ayahs.tr: Allazee lahoo mulkus samaawaati wal ard; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai 'in Shaheed

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire
ayahs.e2: Those who persecute the believing men and women and then do not repent will certainly suffer the punishment of Hell and the torment of burning
ayahs.tr: Innal lazeena fatanul mu'mineena wal mu'minaati summa lam yatooboo falahum 'azaabu Jahannama wa lahum 'azaabul hareeq

ayahs.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment
ayahs.e2: Surely those who believe and do good will have Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the greatest triumph
ayahs.tr: Innal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati lahum Jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaar; zaalikal fawzul kabeer

ayahs.en: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe
ayahs.e2: Indeed, the ˹crushing˺ grip of your Lord is severe

ayahs.en: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats
ayahs.e2: ˹For˺ He is certainly the One Who originates and resurrects ˹all˺

ayahs.en: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate
ayahs.e2: And He is the All-Forgiving, All-Loving—

ayahs.en: Honorable Owner of the Throne
ayahs.e2: Lord of the Throne, the All-Glorious

ayahs.en: Effecter of what He intends
ayahs.e2: Doer of whatever He wills

ayahs.en: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers
ayahs.e2: Has the story of the ˹destroyed˺ forces reached you ˹O Prophet˺—

ayahs.en: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud
ayahs.e2: ˹the forces of˺ Pharaoh and Thamûd

ayahs.en: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial
ayahs.e2: Yet the disbelievers ˹still˺ persist in denial

ayahs.en: While Allah encompasses them from behind
ayahs.e2: But Allah encompasses them from all sides

ayahs.en: But this is an honored Qur'an
ayahs.e2: In fact, this is a glorious Quran

ayahs.en: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate
ayahs.e2: ˹recorded˺ in a Preserved Tablet
